mentions.name: TipTour
mentions.description: Interactive tour guide builder for websites and web apps. A Chrome extension records and builds cursor-following interactive tooltips that integrate into a web app via a single script tag; a macOS local version based on the open source project Clicky is also in development. The project is in discovery mode comparing the web and local form factors.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm building an AI Tour Guide builder for any website or App( https://tiptour.io/ ). I made a chrome extension which helps you record and build interactive cursor following tooltip for your webapp and integrate with your web app using just a script tag.
